name: length_myFilter_le
prelude:
def myFilter (p : α → Bool) : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => if p x then x :: myFilter p xs else myFilter p xs
statement: theorem length_myFilter_le (p : α → Bool) (xs : List α) : (myFilter p xs).length ≤ xs.length
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => simp [myFilter]
  | cons x xs ih => cases h : p x <;> simp [myFilter, h] <;> omega
  have filter_eq (zs : List α) : myFilter p zs = zs.filter p := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => cases h : p z <;> simp [myFilter, List.filter, h, ih]
  rw [filter_eq]
  exact List.length_filter_le p xs
strategies: Direct induction with a Boolean case split on each head.
Identify myFilter with List.filter, then use the library length bound.
